title: How Fashion Startup Fabbric Is Set To Hit $1.6M In A Year Using Clo
description:
Discover how fashion startup FABBRIC leveraged CLO to create an innovative digital design platform, propelling them to a projected $1.6M in revenue within just one year.

"Fabbric is a platform that enables emerging brands and designers to design and manufacture their own fashion collections. To bring fashion and its technical complexity into the digital world, we needed a partner that could provide us with the necessary tools to bridge both worlds. This is how CLO became a fundamental part of our growth. CLO has been crucial for us in everything related to design and patternmaking."

Fabbric Website : https://fabbric.com/es-shop 

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/7814962429977-How-can-I-join-CLO-Discord-

transcript: Fabric is a platform that enables emerging brands and designers to design and manufacture their own fashion collections. To bring fashion and its technical complexity into the digital world, we needed a partner that could provide us with the necessary tools to reach both worlds. This is how Cloth3D became a fundamental part of our growth. Cloth3D has been crucial for us in everything related to design and pattern making. In fact, there are two main advantages I would like to highlight. First one is sample reduction. We used to produce an average of five to six samples per design. Now, thanks to Cloth3D, we only need a maximum of two, which allows us to reduce costs and speed up the development process. And secondly, global collaboration. We work with clients and suppliers from all over the world. So it's essential for us to have software that facilitates real-time communication and the visualization of designs and products. There is no need to have technical knowledge in pattern making or fabrics as all that information is integrated into our platform. With the help of Cloth3D and the feedback from our clients, we have created our own library of patterns. Without a doubt, I would recommend Cloth3D to any company looking for becoming more sustainable and innovative in the fashion industry. And if you have many ideas but no knowledge of design or pattern making, you can always count on Fabric.
markdown_content: ## Overview of Fabric Platform and Its Role in Fashion Design and Manufacturing This section explains **Fabric**, a platform designed to help emerging brands and designers create and manufacture fashion collections by bridging the gap between fashion's technical complexity and digital tools. It introduces **Cloth3D**, a critical software partner enabling this digital transformation. Fabric enables designers and brands to digitally design and manufacture their fashion collections. To address fashion's technical challenges, Fabric partnered with Cloth3D, a software solution that provides essential tools for both design and production workflows. Cloth3D plays a fundamental role in Fabric's growth by integrating fashion design with digital pattern making and visualization. ## Key Advantages of Using Cloth3D in Fashion Development This section highlights the two primary benefits Fabric experienced with Cloth3D: **sample reduction** and **global collaboration**, which enhance cost-efficiency, speed, and communication. 1. **Sample Reduction** Traditionally, Fabric produced five to six physical samples per design, which was costly and time-consuming. With Cloth3D, this number has been reduced to a maximum of two samples per design. This significantly lowers production costs and accelerates the development cycle by enabling virtual prototyping and adjustments before physical sampling. 2. **Global Collaboration** Fabric operates with clients and suppliers worldwide, making real-time communication and visualization essential. Cloth3D facilitates this by enabling stakeholders to view and interact with designs remotely without requiring technical expertise in pattern making or fabric properties. This seamless collaboration improves workflow efficiency and reduces misunderstandings. ## Integration of Technical Knowledge and Pattern Libraries This section covers how Fabric leverages Cloth3D's integration of technical fashion knowledge and client feedback to build proprietary resources. Cloth3D incorporates complex information about pattern making and fabric behavior directly into the platform, removing the need for users to have specialized technical skills. Using this integrated knowledge, along with continuous feedback from clients, Fabric has developed its own comprehensive library of patterns. This resource supports faster, more consistent design and production processes. ## Recommendations and Sustainability Impact This section summarizes Fabric’s endorsement of Cloth3D for companies focused on sustainability and innovation in fashion. Fabric strongly recommends Cloth3D to any company aiming to enhance sustainability and innovation in the fashion industry. By reducing physical samples and streamlining development, Cloth3D helps minimize waste and environmental impact. Additionally, Fabric encourages brands with creative ideas but limited design or pattern-making expertise to leverage Fabric and Cloth3D together for effective product development.
